Package trxsh.ontop.theUltimateSMPLib.sql

Class SQL

java.lang.Object
trxsh.ontop.theUltimateSMPLib.sql.SQL
public class SQL extends Object
SQL helper/wrapper. Used to save data if disk is not used. Try to keep all SQL methods in Async to prevent blocking on the main thread!!
